briefing.headline: OpenAI o4-preview sparks new scaling race as xAI Colossus hits 1M GPUs

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate multi-agent systems amid record compute deployments. China closes gap with DeepSeek-R2 while Western labs focus on reasoning breakthroughs. Regulatory pressure mounts on safety evaluations.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI releases o4-preview with advanced agentic capabilities. Anthropic ships Claude 4 Opus. Google DeepMind unveils Gemini 3 with native tool use. Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B. xAI activates full Colossus cluster for Grok-3 training.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. New NIST guidelines emphasize runtime monitoring. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm production for NVIDIA Blackwell. Microsoft and Oracle announce joint 200k GPU clusters in Europe. Saudi Arabia commits $40B to sovereign AI infrastructure.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent protocol standards like dynamic dialects become mandatory for critical infrastructure before 2028?
